title: State supported and Git-ignored placement requirements for delegated worktrees in the test skill
outcome: The canonical skill clearly limits delegated worktree placement to host-supported, repository-local, Git-ignored paths and explains the unsupported case without permitting outside worktrees.
acceptance: Clarify the skill's .worktrees/delegation-<id> recommendation so it requires host support and a Git-ignored destination, with an explicit stop/report path when the host cannot provide compliant placement.
Coordinate the wording with the host placement owner and the repository authority process; do not duplicate the implementation work or add instruction-phrase tests.
